metadata.authority: Owner-authorized Stage 0 baseline with MPG-DEC-027 and MPG-DEC-028 reconciliation

validationRule: VALIDATED requires suitable evidence; course completion alone does not prove professional delivery capability.
ownerDeclarationRule: A broad owner declaration records the founder's statement only. It is independent of granular evidence maturity and cannot satisfy G2, advance a service, prove delivery, or authorize marketing.

ownerDeclarations.notes: Broad practical-capability declaration only; it does not validate every granular web capability.
Broad practical-capability declaration only; granular business-systems capabilities remain independently assessed.
Broad practical-capability declaration only; granular automation capabilities remain independently assessed.
Broad practical-capability declaration only; no platform, granular skill, proof, delivery process, or capacity is validated.

capabilities.name: Requirements discovery
capabilities.description: Elicit, clarify, document, and confirm client needs and constraints.

capabilities.name: UX and UI design
capabilities.description: Translate user and business needs into usable, accessible interface structures and visual designs.

capabilities.name: Frontend development
capabilities.description: Implement reliable, responsive, accessible browser interfaces.

capabilities.name: Backend development
capabilities.description: Design and implement secure server-side application behavior and data access.

capabilities.name: Deployment and release management
capabilities.description: Deploy, verify, monitor, and safely update production web properties.

capabilities.name: Domain and DNS management
capabilities.description: Configure and troubleshoot domains, DNS, certificates, and ownership handover.

capabilities.name: Web security fundamentals
capabilities.description: Apply proportionate security, access, dependency, data, backup, and incident basics.
capabilities.notes: No certification or professional security claim is made.

capabilities.name: Website quality assurance
capabilities.description: Test functional, responsive, content, compatibility, performance, accessibility, and release acceptance criteria.

capabilities.name: Technical maintenance and support
capabilities.description: Triage, communicate, resolve, escalate, and document post-launch issues within defined support boundaries.

capabilities.name: Business analysis
capabilities.description: Identify business needs, stakeholders, constraints, value, and solution fit.

capabilities.name: Workflow modelling
capabilities.description: Map current and target processes, decisions, exceptions, roles, and handoffs.

capabilities.name: Database design
capabilities.description: Design appropriate data models, integrity rules, access patterns, and lifecycle controls.

capabilities.name: Integration architecture
capabilities.description: Define safe, maintainable system boundaries, interfaces, ownership, and failure handling.

capabilities.name: Change management
capabilities.description: Plan adoption, stakeholder communication, training, transition, and outcome review.

capabilities.name: Automation opportunity identification
capabilities.description: Identify stable, valuable, measurable processes suitable for automation rather than automating ambiguity.

capabilities.name: Workflow automation
capabilities.description: Implement controlled workflows with validation, fallbacks, ownership, and maintainability.

capabilities.name: API integration
capabilities.description: Integrate systems using authenticated interfaces, contracts, rate limits, retries, and error handling.

capabilities.name: AI workflow design
capabilities.description: Design bounded AI-assisted workflows with realistic claims, data controls, human oversight, evaluation, and fallback.

capabilities.name: Automation monitoring
capabilities.description: Detect, diagnose, communicate, and recover from workflow failures and quality drift.

capabilities.name: Mobile discovery and requirements
capabilities.description: Define the user, business, device, platform, data, integration, release, support, and constraint requirements for a mobile application.
capabilities.notes: No proficiency, platform scope, or delivery readiness is claimed.

capabilities.name: Mobile user experience
capabilities.description: Design usable mobile interaction flows and interface behavior appropriate to defined users, devices, and accessibility needs.
capabilities.notes: No proficiency or supported-platform claim is made.

capabilities.name: Mobile application development
capabilities.description: Implement a mobile application within an explicitly assessed technical and platform boundary.
capabilities.notes: No language, framework, operating system, device, or delivery proficiency is asserted.

capabilities.name: Mobile platform and device testing
capabilities.description: Test defined functionality, compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, data, and release criteria across an approved device and platform scope.
capabilities.notes: No device inventory, test environment, scope, or proficiency is asserted.

capabilities.name: Mobile release and deployment
capabilities.description: Prepare, authorize, release, verify, monitor, and safely update mobile software within defined account and platform responsibilities.
capabilities.notes: No store account, release authority, process, or proficiency is asserted.

capabilities.name: Mobile maintenance and support
capabilities.description: Triage, communicate, resolve, escalate, update, and document mobile application issues within an approved support boundary.
capabilities.notes: No maintenance capability, service level, platform scope, or support commitment is asserted.

capabilities.name: Marketing strategy
capabilities.description: Connect audience, positioning, offer, channel, message, evidence, and measurement decisions.

capabilities.name: Copywriting
capabilities.description: Write clear, truthful, audience-relevant marketing and conversion copy.

capabilities.name: Content planning and production operations
capabilities.description: Plan sustainable content themes, formats, production, approvals, rights, publishing, and reuse.

capabilities.name: Paid advertising
capabilities.description: Plan, operate, measure, and control paid campaigns within platform, budget, claims, and tracking constraints.

capabilities.name: Marketing analytics
capabilities.description: Define trustworthy measurement, instrumentation, interpretation, reporting, and limitations.

capabilities.name: Search visibility and SEO
capabilities.description: Improve discoverability using ethical, technically sound, evidence-led search practices without ranking guarantees.
capabilities.notes: No proficiency or ranking claim is made.

capabilities.name: Conversion optimization
capabilities.description: Use appropriate evidence and experiments to improve user journeys and defined business outcomes.

capabilities.name: Supplier sourcing
capabilities.description: Identify potential suppliers against defined, lawful commercial requirements.
capabilities.notes: No supplier network or proficiency is claimed.

capabilities.name: Supplier verification
capabilities.description: Apply proportionate, documented checks while disclosing limits and residual risk.
capabilities.notes: No verification service or guarantee is claimed.

capabilities.name: Procurement coordination
capabilities.description: Coordinate requirements, quotations, approvals, orders, documentation, and issue handling.

capabilities.name: Commercial negotiation
capabilities.description: Prepare and conduct bounded commercial negotiations with clear authority and documented terms.

capabilities.name: Freight and logistics coordination
capabilities.description: Coordinate defined logistics activities through appropriately qualified parties without misrepresenting MPG's role.
capabilities.notes: Likely partner dependence must be assessed; no partner or proficiency is currently validated.

capabilities.name: Import and export knowledge
capabilities.description: Understand applicable trade processes, documents, roles, risks, and jurisdiction-specific professional boundaries.
capabilities.notes: No licensing, compliance, or professional claim is made.

capabilities.name: Market representation
capabilities.description: Represent a principal only under verified authority, documented responsibilities, lawful terms, and accurate public disclosure.
capabilities.notes: Likely partner or principal dependence must be assessed; no representation authority, relationship, or proficiency is claimed.
